header: The page's plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs: the launcher, Load ROM on a new profile, Start Game,
then the title (the game's state 2, read in RDRAM: in Firefox the console line saying so comes before the plan
plays) and a Normal Championship's first three races as tools/shader_plan.json's second championship section plays
them: the menus passed by pressing until the game's state (gGameState, 0x800DAB24) says the next screen is up, each
race raced 30 s with the gas held and tools/autopilot.js steering, then ended by putting the rider on its last lap
with every buoy taken, and its finish and results pressed through to the next race (Sunny Beach, Sunset Bay, Marine
Fortress) and, after the third, to the screens a championship ends with when the rider doesn't qualify. A race's
time is the game's own (the frame counter at 0x80151960, 20 a second): ridden longer the autopilot misses enough
buoys to be disqualified, and one disqualified sooner (state 0x29) races the course again, which the plan takes as
the next race. Load ROM waits for the shader list Chrome builds behind the launcher (a laptop's GPU busy with it
took no click until it was done); Firefox builds none there, and its line saying so is the one waited for.
